parameters.help_en: The name of the general-purpose resource group. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_). It can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 创建通用资源组的名称，必须以字母开头，可包含字母、数字、下划线（_），最多128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: Create a serverless resource group for common tasks
parameters.help_en: The remark of the general-purpose resource group. It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). It can be up to 128 characters in length

parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the resource group. PrePaid indicates subscription, and PostPaid indicates pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的付费类型，PrePaid代表包年包月，PostPaid代表按量付费
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: The unit of the billing duration. Month indicates months, and Year indicates years
parameters.help_zh: 付费时长单位，Month代表包月，Year代表包年
parameters.name: payment_duration_unit

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the resource group. Unit: CU. This parameter is required when the billing method of the resource group is PrePaid
